parsed.rationale: Although both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with `shared_field_count: 2` and no restraint markers, they carry different names (`PauseWXYC` in `Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/PauseWXYC.swift` vs. `WhatsPlayingOnWXYC` in `WXYC/iOS/Intents.swift`) and live in different packages (`Intents` vs. `app:iOS`). The differing names strongly suggest they represent distinct Siri/App Intents actions — one for pausing playback and one for querying what is currently playing — whose structural similarity (both being zero-field type-alias objects wrapping an intent class) is purely coincidental to the Intents framework pattern. Merging or aliasing them would conflate two semantically unrelated user-facing intent actions, and the `Intents` shared package already exists as the canonical home for intent types, so no extraction is needed.
